igor kozlov.title: Igor Kozlov
igor kozlov.text:
Igor is a resourceful and resilient family man, middle aged 67 years old, living in the utopian city-state of a post-war society. Known for his poorly played guitar melodies, Igor salvages what he can from the abandoned outskirts to make ends meet. He works officially for the city-state security, but since society is relatively stable, he also has a semi-official role in surveying surrounding areas for potential threats or valuable resources.
[url=family]family[/url] - woman partner, kid, brother and parents.
Works for city state security. He do it on his own - city state V4 is post scarcity society.
Satisfied family man well established in society with bit above average knack for adventure, collecting things from before populist wars and playing guitar.

family.title: family
family.text:
Good standard relationship with his wife Kristin(age 58) and daughter Rebecca(13).
His brother Gustav (age 98) is typical member of V4 city state post scarcity society. Enjoys life, meets with people, woman do some art. Bit suspicious about [url=igor kozlov]his brother[/url] work, cant understand why would somebody do this. Makes fun out of [url=igor kozlov]Igor's[/url] guitar playing.
Igor's parents, at 160 years old, reside in a  virtual facility care  managed by the city-state AI, in line with the common "mind upload" tradition.
